riddle: I'm the green chat app on every Indian phone. Family groups use me for good-morning flowers, forwards and very long voice notes. What am I?
I'm a photo-sharing app with a camera logo in sunset colours. People post reels and stories on me and keep checking their follower count. What app am I?
You're using me right now. I have servers, channels, voice chats and roles, and gamers made me popular. What app am I?
You can't see me, but a blinking box at home sends me around the house so your phone gets internet. Guests always ask for my password first. What am I?
I'm a funny still picture with a caption, copied and re-captioned thousands of times, and shared in every group chat. What am I?
I'm a short, silent clip that plays on a loop. You send me instead of typing a reply, and people still fight over how to say my name. What am I?
My logo is a red rectangle with a white play button. Every creator on me begs you to like, share and subscribe. What am I?
When you don't know something, you ask me. My name became a verb, and my logo wears four colours. What am I?
I'm a tiny picture you drop into a message: a heart, a thumbs up, or a yellow face crying with laughter. What am I?
I'm a streaming service with a red N logo. My shows start with a deep drum sound, and I ask if you're still watching. What am I?
I'm a black-and-white square pattern stuck at every chai stall and sabzi cart. Point your camera at me and you can pay. What am I?
I'm a picture of your own phone screen, made by pressing two buttons at once. In group-chat fights I'm used as proof. What am I?
When there's no internet, Chrome shows a small dinosaur. Press space and it jumps over cactuses forever. What is this game called?
hint: Appears when the net is down.

riddle: Everything in my world is made of blocks. You punch trees for wood, mine for diamonds and build a house before the night monsters come. What game am I?
You jump out of a plane onto an island with 99 others, grab guns and a pan, stay inside the shrinking circle, and hope to win a chicken dinner. India has its own version of me. What game am I?
I'm a yellow electric mouse with red cheeks. I refuse to stay inside my ball and ride on my trainer's shoulder. Who am I?
I'm a plumber in a red cap and blue overalls. Mushrooms make me bigger, and I keep rescuing a princess from a castle. Who am I?
Pocket monsters live inside red-and-white balls, and trainers travel the world trying to catch every single one. What franchise am I?
I'm a yellow circle with a big mouth, eating dots in a maze while four ghosts chase me. Who am I?
Match three sweets in a row to clear them. Your relatives keep sending you requests for extra lives in me. What game am I?
A kid sprays graffiti on a train, then runs along the tracks forever, chased by an inspector and his dog. What game am I?
Four colours, one dice, and every piece must reach home. During lockdown whole families played my phone version for hours. What game am I?
Crewmates fix a spaceship, but one of them is secretly the impostor. Emergency meetings end with someone being voted out. What game am I?
On old Nokia phones I grew longer every time I ate a dot, and the game ended if I bit my own tail. What game am I?
Three engineering college friends, a strict director nicknamed Virus, and a message to chase excellence instead of marks. What Bollywood film am I?
I'm a blue robot cat from the future with no ears and a pocket full of gadgets, always saving a lazy boy. Who am I?
I'm a strong little boy from Dholakpur and laddoos give me my power. Who am I?
A TV quiz show where Amitabh Bachchan asks questions worth crores, and you can phone a friend when stuck. What show am I?
Celebrities are locked in a house full of cameras for weeks, an unseen deep voice gives them tasks, and Salman Khan scolds them on weekends. What show am I?
Noble families scheme for an iron throne, a young man of the Night's Watch guards a giant wall of ice, and winter is always coming. What series am I?
Six friends in New York spend most of their time on an orange couch in a coffee shop. What series am I?
Robbers wear red jumpsuits and painter's-face masks, and a quiet man they call the Professor plans everything. What series am I?
I'm a British spy with a licence to kill, a tuxedo, fancy cars and a number with two zeros. Who am I?
A lion cub prince, a warthog and meerkat who teach him not to worry, and a baboon who lifts him high on a rock. What film am I?
A cowboy doll and a space-ranger toy come to life whenever the kid who owns them leaves the room. What film am I?
A father trains his two daughters to become wrestling champions in a village akhada. What Bollywood film am I?
A family sitcom about the neighbours of Gokuldham Society, running on TV for years and years. What show am I?
A famous 70s Bollywood film: two friends hired to protect a village, a coin toss, and a villain named Gabbar. What film am I?
A bite in a science lab gave me my powers. I shoot webs from my wrists and swing between buildings in New York. Who am I?
Billionaire by day, I protect Gotham at night in a black cape. I have no superpowers, just gadgets. Who am I?
I came from another planet and was raised on a farm. Glasses make me a reporter, a red cape makes me fly, and green rocks make me weak. Who am I?
A genius billionaire who built a metal suit in a cave. I'm red and gold with a glowing circle in my chest. Who am I?
I'm a scientist who turns huge and green when I get angry, and then I smash. Who am I?
India's own 90s TV superhero. I spin into my costume, and my other life is a clumsy newspaper photographer named Gangadhar. Who am I?
I'm a purple giant who collects six stones in a golden glove, and I wipe out half of all life with one snap. Who am I?
Green hair, a painted smile, a name from a deck of cards, and Batman's worst enemy. Who am I?
Every summer, city teams in India play me, players are auctioned for crores, and matches are three hours of loud cricket. What am I?
A bowler takes three wickets on three balls in a row. What is that called?
The batter's nightmare: out without scoring a single run. I share my name with a bird that quacks. What am I?
We're three wooden poles standing at each end of the pitch. Hit us with the ball and the batter is out. What are we?
Yellow packet, a two-minute promise that's never really two minutes, and a little masala tastemaker sachet. Hostel students love me. What am I?
I'm a cheap, cheerful glucose biscuit with a little girl on my wrapper. Dunk me in chai, but not too long. What am I?
My mascot is a little girl in a polka-dot frock who comments on the news on billboards. My butter is on half of India's toast. Which brand am I?
I'm a mango drink in a green tetra pack, sipped through a tiny straw at every kids' birthday party. What am I?
I'm a fizzy Indian cola with a thumbs-up gesture in my name, and my ads call me strong. What am I?
Golden arches, a clown mascot, and in India an aloo tikki burger. Which fast-food chain am I?
I'm named after an old Danish king known for a bad tooth. I let your phone talk to earbuds and speakers without any wire. What am I?
I'm the pair of marks next to your WhatsApp message. When we turn blue, the other person has read it, and silence after that starts fights. What are we?
I'm not an app, but GPay, PhonePe and Paytm all run on me. I'm India's system for instant payments from one bank account to another. What am I?
I once lived on the phone keypad as 'pound' or 'number'. Now I sit in front of words and make them trend. What am I?
An unknown number calls, but I tell you the name before you pick up, and I paint spammers red. What app am I?
I became famous in lockdown for video calls, and my name also means what a camera does when it moves in closer. What app am I?
I'm a free encyclopedia that anyone can edit. Teachers said don't cite me; students read me anyway. My logo is a globe of puzzle pieces. What am I?
I'm a guessing game with five-letter words and six tries. Green means right spot, yellow means wrong spot. What game am I?
Two teams on maps like Dust2: one side plants a bomb, the other must defuse it. I ruled Indian cyber cafes and still run big esports. What game am I?
A mobile battle royale by Garena, with short ten-minute matches, that runs even on cheap phones. What game am I?
I'm a spiky-shelled turtle king who keeps kidnapping Princess Peach. Who am I?
I'm the Norse god of thunder's hammer. Only someone worthy can lift me. What am I?
I'm a glowing sword of light from a galaxy far away. Blue or green for heroes, red for the dark side. What am I?
I'm a dark lord in a black helmet who breathes heavily through a mask, and I reveal that I'm the hero's father. Who am I?
I'm a small gold band that makes the wearer invisible. I was forged in a volcano, and a hobbit must throw me back in. What am I?
A hidden African kingdom disguised as a poor country, rich in a rare metal, ruled by a king in a cat suit. What place am I?
I'm a red-suited mercenary who can't die, won't stop joking, and keeps talking straight to the audience. Who am I?
A pill choice: one shows you the real world, the other lets you keep believing. Leather coats and dodging bullets in slow motion. What film am I?
A Bollywood love story: two young NRIs fall for each other on a Europe trip, and he refuses to elope until her strict father in Punjab gives his blessing. What film am I?
A lovable Mumbai goon joins a medical college and treats patients with kindness and a magic hug. What film am I?
A grumpy old garage owner and his two broke tenants pick up a wrong-number call from kidnappers and plot to grab the ransom. What Bollywood comedy am I?
Wear my special gadget and you turn invisible, seen only under red light. My villain keeps announcing that he is pleased. What film am I?
Three school friends take a bachelor road trip across Spain, and they face deep-sea diving, skydiving and running with bulls. What film am I?
Villagers who can't pay their tax challenge British officers to a cricket match to cancel it. What film am I?
A loyal old swordsman kills the hero, and the whole country spends two years asking why. What film am I?
A masked Bollywood superhero with a black jacket, son of a man whose best friend was a blue alien. Who am I?
An ACP, an officer who breaks every door with one kick, and a forensic lab: India's longest-running detective show. What am I?
A black-and-white web series about students in a Rajasthan coaching town, preparing for IIT with a teacher everyone calls Jeetu Bhaiya. What show am I?
An engineering graduate takes a low-paid job as secretary of a village office in UP, and learns to love the place. What series am I?
A boy who struggles to read is called lazy, until a new art teacher sees that he has dyslexia. What film am I?
An old man whose brain works faster than a computer, and his giant friend Sabu from Jupiter. Which comic hero am I?
I'm a full, fast ball aimed right at the batter's toes, very hard to dig out at the death. What am I?
A leg-spinner's trick ball that spins the opposite way to what the batter expects. What am I?
A wristy whip of the bat that swings round like a rotor, made famous by India's calm captain from Ranchi. What shot am I?
The ball would have hit the stumps, but your pad got in the way. What kind of out am I?
The match is tied, so each team gets just six more balls to settle it. What am I?
After a no-ball, the next delivery is special: the batter can't be caught or bowled. What is that ball called?
I'm an orange powder that turns water into a sweet drink. In my ads a little girl said she loved me, and summer at home meant a big jug of me. What am I?
I'm a tangy, chatpata digestive tablet in a small round bottle, eaten after heavy meals. What am I?
A small blue jar of menthol rub your mother put on your chest and nose whenever you had a cold. What am I?
A hard candy tasting of raw mango, with a surprise of tangy spicy powder in the middle. What am I?
A crunchy orange corn snack whose shape is twisted and crooked on purpose. What am I?
A thumping motorcycle, loved by road trippers riding to Ladakh; my most famous model is called Bullet. Which brand am I?
An old phone so tough that jokes say the floor cracks when I fall. I had Snake and a week-long battery, and was relaunched in 2017. What model am I?
When rain cuts a limited-overs match short, I'm the mathematical method that sets the new target, and nobody outside the scorers truly understands me. What am I?
My name means 'the second one'. I'm an off-spinner's secret ball that turns the other way. What am I?
England and Australia fight over a tiny urn said to hold burnt cricket gear. What is this series called?
In the IPL I'm worn by whoever has scored the most runs so far; my colour rival goes to the top wicket-taker. What am I?
I'm a lower-order batter sent in near the end of the day to protect the star batters, though my title sounds like I guard a building. What am I?
I'm an antiseptic cream in a green tube with an elephant on it, a Bengali household cure for cracked lips and heels. Which brand am I?
A women's cooperative from Mumbai makes me by hand, and my mascot is a cheerful bunny. Which brand am I?
Round, white and sturdy, I carried officials and families across India for decades, made by Hindustan Motors. What car am I?
I'm a mascot with a big curled moustache and a turban who bows to welcome passengers of India's oldest airline. Who am I?
On 90s video game consoles, two commandos in bandanas run and gun through jungles, and a famous secret code gives you 30 lives. What game am I?
An old PC racing game in cyber cafes where you ride a motorbike and punch and kick other riders off the road. What game am I?
Cartoon soldiers with jetpacks fly around 2D maps, and friends battle each other over a phone hotspot, no internet needed. What mobile game am I?
You click a link promising something exciting, and instead an 80s music video of a man in a trench coat starts dancing. What prank am I?
A Shiba Inu dog looking sideways, surrounded by broken English in colourful Comic Sans, later inspired a cryptocurrency. What meme am I?
In 2020 a man's name started appearing in every YouTube comment section in India, until even big brands joined the joke. What name am I?
A blue alien who draws power from sunlight, left behind on Earth, gives a kind, childlike young man special powers in a 2003 Bollywood film. Who am I?
An Indian comic superhero who can shoot tiny snakes from his wrists and is immune to poison. Who am I?
Two lazy dreamers compete to marry a rich heiress, and a villain named Crime Master Gogo shows up. What cult Bollywood comedy am I?
I'm the rare metal of Wakanda. Captain America's shield is made of me. What am I?
hint: Black Panther's suit is laced with it.

riddle: I'm green, silent and have no arms. I walk up behind you, hiss, and hug your house into a crater. Who am I?
Two low notes, repeated faster and faster, and suddenly nobody wants to go in the water. I made a whole generation afraid of beaches. What film am I?
I'm a test set by machines to catch machines. Pick every square with a traffic light, and if you fail, you might be a robot. What am I?
An astronaut farmer leaves his daughter to find a new planet, falls into a black hole, and talks to her through her bookshelf. What film am I?
A tomboy who loves basketball, a friendship band, and letters written by a mother to her daughter to be read on her birthdays. What film am I?
Two revolutionaries, one on a motorbike and one on a horse, save a boy from a burning bridge, and their dance-off song won an Oscar. What film am I?
